officialSource.section: Accumulate costs across multiple calls; Track costs in streaming input mode
officialSource.paraphrase: Versions from 2.1.277 restore normally exited session spend on resume. Cost and modelUsage may include restored spend/subagents; usage covers main-loop turn activity. Native cost figures remain client-side estimates, not billing receipts.

scopeBoundary: Official version semantics plus saved init support this version condition; they do not independently prove invoice amount or every reset/crash boundary. No extra native/model call performed.
